title: Live Training Quiz
description: Schema for quiz.json (QUIZ_PATH). Matches validateQuiz in src/quiz.ts.

title.description: Non-empty quiz title (whitespace-only rejected at load).

metadata.description: Optional authoring bag for non-gameplay data (tags, source IDs, CMS fields). Arbitrary nested JSON values allowed. Omitted or null → absent at load.

text.description: Non-empty question prompt. Markdown is supported.

choices.description: Answer options; at least two non-empty strings.

correct.description: 0-based index into choices; must be < choices.length (enforced at load).

explain.description: Optional explanation after reveal. Omitted or null → empty string at load. Markdown is supported.

metadata.description: Optional authoring bag per question (domain, use-case, live, tags, …). Arbitrary nested JSON values allowed. Omitted or null → absent at load. Used by startup filters; not part of quiz fingerprint.
